prompt:
Find the Raspberry Pi Foundation's or Raspberry Pi Ltd's official statement about how long the Raspberry Pi 5 will remain in production. Cite the official page and quote it.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the official product brief and commercial pages from Raspberry Pi Ltd, the Raspberry Pi 5 is guaranteed to remain in production until at least January 2036. While a news article mentions a date of January 2038, the primary product documentation consistently cites January 2036 as the minimum production lifetime.

SOURCE: https://pip-assets.raspberrypi.com/categories/892-raspberry-pi-5/documents/RP-008348-DS-8-raspberry-pi-5-product-brief.pdf | QUOTE: "Raspberry Pi 5 will remain in production until at least January 2036" | CLAIM: The official product brief states the minimum production lifetime for the Raspberry Pi 5 ends in January 2036.

SOURCE: https://www.raspberrypi.com/products/raspberry-pi-5/?resellerType=industry | QUOTE: "Raspberry Pi 5 will remain in production until at least January 2036" | CLAIM: The official commercial product page confirms the production lifetime extends until at least January 2036.

SOURCE: https://datasheets.raspberrypi.com/rpi5/raspberry-pi-5-product-brief.pdf | QUOTE: "Production lifetime: Raspberry Pi 5 will remain in production until at least January 2036" | CLAIM: The datasheet product brief reiterates the January 2036 minimum production date.

SOURCE: https://www.raspberrypi.com/news/raspberry-pis-commitment-to-longevity-a-sustainable-advantage/ | QUOTE: "Take the flagship Raspberry Pi 5, for example: it has a guaranteed minimum manufacturing end date of January 2038, with production of many of its key silicon components extending as far as 2042." | CLAIM: A news article regarding sustainability claims a later date of January 2038, which conflicts with the product brief's January 2036 date.
